newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia's Unibanka to make GDR issue.
newsitem.headline: Latvia's Unibanka to make GDR issue.

text.p: Leading Latvian bank Unibanka said on Thursday it was to make an issue of global depositary receipts (GDR) via securities house Nomura.
An Unibanka spokeswoman confirmed newspaper reports that the GDR issue would take place but did not say how much it would be worth.
Lithuania's Vilnius Bank was the first bank from the former Soviet Union to make a GDR issue, releasing some $17.1 million in mid-summer.
Unibanka vies for the top spot among Latvia's banks with privately-owned Parex Bank.
The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is a major shareholder in Unibanka, which is the leading stock on the Latvian stock market.
